production.note: US model years. First: Mitsubishi's 24 March 2005 release introduces the Lancer Evolution IX as a 2006 model ('The 2006 Lancer Evolution features a standard two-liter DOHC 16-valve I-4 intercooled turbocharged engine'). Last: a March 2007 road test is headed '2007 Mitsubishi Lancer EVOLUTION MR' (tac-2007-evo-mr-review), and Mitsubishi's November 2007 release introduces the all-new 2008 Lancer Evolution, calling the IX 'the previous-generation Evolution IX' (mitsubishi-us-2007-evo-x-release). No opened Mitsubishi page says in so many words that 2007 was the last model year.

body.note: 'The Lancer Evolution sedan's four-wheel independent suspension ...'

configuration.note: 'two-liter DOHC 16-valve I-4 intercooled turbocharged engine' (4G63 with MIVEC)

displacementL.note: 1,997 cc ('1997cc/ 85mm x 88mm', 2006 Lancer Evolution column, engine code 4G63)

fuel.note: Inferred from the release's description of the turbocharged petrol 4G63 engine.

drivetrain.note: 'Full-time all-wheel drive with an active center differential (ACD)'

transmission.note: '5-speed manual (GSR, RS) or 6speed manual (MR)' (GSR is Mitsubishi's internal name for the standard car). The launch release: 'standard five-speed manual transmission'; 'The Lancer Evolution MR features a six-speed close-ratio manual transmission.' (mitsubishi-us-2005-evo-ix-release). No automatic was offered.

powerHp.note: Quote: "The improved powerplant reaches 286 horsepower at 6,500 rpm and 289 foot-pounds of torque at a very low 3,500 rpm." Same rating for the standard car, RS and MR. Mitsubishi's 2008 release repeats it for the outgoing engine: "291 hp at 6,500 rpm (vs. 286 hp at 6,500 rpm)" (mitsubishi-us-2007-evo-x-release).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL: a database, matched by a table printed with a single article. Standard Lancer Evolution IX (not RS or MR), 5-speed manual, 2006 model. Quote (Edmunds, 'IX 4dr Sedan AWD (2.0L 4cyl Turbo 5M)'): "Curb weight | 3,274 lbs.". The 'TECH SPECS' table printed with Mark Fulmer's launch review on The Auto Channel (tac-2005-evo-ix-fulmer, marked 'Last updated: 8/3/05', not attributed to Mitsubishi) gives the same: "Curb Weight (lbs/kg) | 3219/1460 | 3274/1485 | 3285/1490" (columns 'RS', 'Evolution IX', 'MR Edition'). Mitsubishi's own newsroom pages for this car give no weight.

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 3,274 lb for the standard 2006 Evolution IX rests on Edmunds (a database), matched by an unattributed table printed with The Auto Channel's launch review. Mitsubishi's 2006 US press-kit specification sheet, or a Car and Driver, Road & Track or MotorTrend spec panel, would replace it. The end year (2007) is inferred from a 2007-model road test and Mitsubishi's 2008 Evolution X release calling the IX the previous generation; no Mitsubishi page states it outright.
